programme.desc: Presented as a leisurely variety show, the program revolves around the theme: 'Seek Paradise Along the Journey to Kunlun Mountain.' This immersive experience seeks to rediscover the essence of life, allowing our weary hearts to shine anew amidst the dust of daily grind.

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 俞笑擁有一段令人外人羨慕的婚姻，然而因一起女高中生的遇害案，警察宋誠發現俞笑成了其與手頭一樁塵封舊案的共同證人，調查過程中，警方發現俞笑丈夫朱鶴好好男人的外表下，藏著無數與案件相關的線索。而對於俞笑而言，遇見宋誠和身份成謎的安妮後，她開始直面多年前的陰影……

programme.title: E28
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E20
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: E111 - Shrunken Ships/The Pirate Parade
programme.desc: When Escarlata turns the crew tiny, they have to find a pint-sized way to save the day. // It's time for the annual Pirate Parade! That is, unless Escarlata has anything to say about it.

programme.title: E103 - Boris/Born To Be Wild
programme.desc: The barbababies find a lost baby elephant and secretly look after it. How will Barbapapa and Barbamama react to Boris? // Boris the elephant misses home. The Barbapapa decide to bring him back to Africa. On the spot, they help Boris to acclimatize.

programme.title: E921 - Pups Save A Flamingo Dancer/Pups Save A Mayor And Her Mini
programme.desc: The Paw Patrol searches for Julia, Julius and a flamingo when they go missing from a dance contest. // The Paw Patrol comes to the rescue when Mayor Goodway and her niece Julia get stuck on a runaway art installation.

programme.title: E922 - Pups Save The Wind Trekkers/Pups Save A Trophy
programme.desc: When Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta get trapped inside a mesa, it's up to the Paw Patrol and a little snake to rescue them. // When Humdinger's mom Helga loses her son's phony trophy, the Paw Patrol have to rescue her and the trophy.

programme.title: E305 - The Crystal Of Strength/Clamity
programme.desc: Injured from training and eager to feel strong again, Rammy gets the squad to go in search of the legendary Crystal of Strength on Sparkle Island. // When Steel takes a pearl from a clam, it chases him through the city to try and get the pearl back.

programme.title: E214 - The Crew Builds A Pizza Parlor/The Crew Builds An Airport Road
programme.desc: Mayor Greatway needs a lot of pizzas, fast! But when Speed Meister steps in, the pups have to fix his pizza problem. // When a family can't get to the airport in time on Speed Meister's road, Rubble & Crew has to build a new road before takeoff.

programme.title: E511 - Super Perrito/Benny And The Pets
programme.desc: When Perrito puts on a cape that gives him superpowers, Dora, Boots, and 'Super Perrito' zoom around the rainforest saving friends in need! // Dora and Boots help their friend Benny find his perfect pet among all the adorable pets at Pick-a-Pet Park.

programme.title: E207 - Don't Go Grandma/Stuck/Rocket Track
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy & Tia try to stop Grandma from leaving, so they can spend more time with her / When Terri & Tommy get locked in the Garden Dome, they must put their differences aside to try to escape / Tim tries to help Tia face the new Rocket track ride.

programme.title: E107 - The Crew Builds A Beaver Home/The Crew Fixes A Road
programme.desc: The power is out in Builder Cove! When the pups find out a beaver is to blame, they've got to build him a new home to bring the power back. // When Speed Meister damages the road ahead of the town helper parade, the pups work fast to repave the way.

programme.title: E304 - The Secret Island/Astrobot
programme.desc: Lady Fluffpot visits a secret island with Steel to find a birthday present from her cousin Adventure Alex. // Muffin's plan to get Dinobot into trouble goes disastrously wrong when the pair get trapped with Lola in an out-of-control Space Shuttle.

programme.title: E211 - The Great Abuela Cookoff/Missing Map
programme.desc: After the Pokey Pigeons eat all of Abuela's elotes, Dora and Boots set out to find more ingredients for the Great Abuela Cook-off. / Dora, Boots and Backpack play an adventurous game of Hide-and-Seek to find Map.

programme.title: E110 - The Enchanted Melody/Chicken Abuelo
programme.desc: When Escarlata gets ahold of an enchanted guitar riff, all of the underseas may soon fall under her spell. // Tomas accidentally turns Abuelo into a chicken!

programme.title: E111 - The Grass Is Always Greener.../When I Grow Up
programme.desc: Barbabright coats the house in magic product to prevent water leakage. The next day, The house deflates like a balloon. // A bird builds its nest on Barbazoo's belly. Barbazoo wants to become a big tree to shelter animals. This becomes complicated.

programme.title: E104 - The Hunt For The Hidden Hive/The Trouble Of The Toppled Trees
programme.desc: Special agent Indie helps the pals reunite a lost bee with the rest of her hive. // Sam and Kit try to uncover who has been chewing down the forest trees.

programme.title: E304 - The Crew Builds A Super Mega Movie Screen/The Crew Builds An Auntie Day P
programme.desc: A new Super Squirrely Whirly movie is playing at the drive-in theater! But when Speed Meister gets in the way, the pups spring into action to save the day. // It's Auntie Day! But can the pups finish building their present for Auntie Crane in time?

programme.title: E305 - The Crew Builds A Giant Skate Track/The Crew Builds A Giant Ice Cream Mak
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew help River take lots of pictures for the big photo contest by building a super-fast way to get around Bulider Cove. // Rubble and the pups help Cafe Carl make enough ice cream for everyone! If Speed Meister doesn't get in the way...

programme.title: E102 - Bada-Bam/The Barbamartians
programme.desc: Barbabright captured a melody from Mars. The Barbapapas build a rocket to go to the red planet. // While travelling to Mars, the Barbapapas meet a family of Barbamartians. They have no time to get acquainted when a giant plant attacks the village.

programme.title: E216 - Pirate Island
programme.desc: Grandpa and Granny Pig are taking Peppa, George and their friends to Pirate Island. Grandpa shows how to use his metal detector to find treasures and they all build a big sandcastle.

programme.title: E205 - The Cloud Kingdom
programme.desc: Dora and Boots meet Vicky the Vicuna who is missing her magic flute that she needs to go back to the Cloud Kingdom.

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

Ghost Cat Anzu
programme.desc: Karin, 11 years old, finds herself abandoned by her father in a small Japanese town, where her grandfather, a monk, resides. Her grandfather asks Anzu, his jovial and helpful, although rather capricious, ghost cat, to look after her. As their spirited personalities collide, sparks fly-yet perhaps only in the beginning.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: The middle-aged Boss Tai owns an Internet cafe that has long since lost popularity; Bond, an e-sports player who is not yet in his thirties, is facing a career dilemma of declining strength; Fey grew up in a single-parent family, and she has been unemployed for more than five years since she graduated from college; The former action star Ba Ye, because his wife Ah Lan suffered from brain degeneration, the two over 70 years old tried to use video games to exercise their brains. Seeing a solicitation for a Hong Kong e-sports competition led Boss Tai, who wanted to save the Internet cafe, to form a team. Boss Tai, Fey, and Ba Ye, three rookies plus a young master, Bond, who is eager to prove himself, officially established the Happy Hour e-sports team. Family and friendship turned into a battle in the e-sports arena, an impossible battle that stopped them from regretting their dreams.

programme.desc: Loving in Tandem follows Shine, a cheerful and resilient young woman who will do anything for her family but struggles when it comes to love. programme.title: May Halimaw Sa Likod Ng Salamin
programme.desc: Presented by ABS-CBN News Documentaries, “May Halimaw sa Likod ng Salamin” (There's a Monster Behind the Screen) is a documentary by journalist Lyza Aquino that looks into “online grooming” and the radicalization of children into nihilistic violent extremist communities, where mass shootings and other acts of violence are glorified. The documentary follows “Cosmo” and “Anne,” two teens who were approached by online groomers and found themselves exposed to these communities, but eventually managed to break away. Their stories provide a look into how grooming happens, how violent ideologies are introduced to young people, and how the line between an online connection and real-world danger can disappear. Experts also offer pathways to help protect our children from these so-called “monsters”.

programme.title: Finale In Blood
programme.desc: An unusual story about an unusual love. Fang Yin comes from countryside to take over and run her father's hotel. She finds herself unable to cope. In distress, she turns to the first man ever to enter her life. It's a big mistake. One night, radio announcer Cheng Ming-pao is saved from drowning by the umbrella. He and she meet and confide in each other. It's Fang Yin's turn to tell Cheng Ming-pao she must leave him and that her ex-lover must pay the debt in kind...

programme.title: Legacy Of Rage
programme.desc: Brandon Ma, a regular guy working in Hong Kong, who is set up by his drug-dealing best friend Michael, to take the rap for the murder of an undercover cop. Michael also has eyes for Brandon's girl, May. While Brandon languishes in jail, May gives birth to their child and flees to Brazil to avoid the lurid clutches of Michael, who has become a big crime boss. Brandon gets out of prison after eight years, learns the truth, and goes after Michael for revenge...

programme.title: Heart Against Hearts
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex and Chu Lai Ngo, played by George Lam and Do Do Cheng, finally get married and live with Chu's daughter Vivian, played by Vivian Chow. Since the owner of the advertising company migrates, Alex starts to take control of the company. However, the company is forced to close down due to the banker goes bankrupt. Besides, Chu and Vivian both join a financial investment company owned by Alex's old classmate ET, acted by Paul Chun. Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud...
